title: 2026 Imagine Cup Competition
summary: The 2026 Imagine Cup is a global student startup competition where participants transform innovative ideas into real-world solutions. Students gain access to Microsoft's AI technologies, receive tailored guidance, and connect with experts to refine their products and grow as entrepreneurs. This competition offers a unique opportunity for aspiring student founders to develop their ventures with significant support and resources.
